import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re

# --- simple Needleman-Wunsch with BLOSUM62 ---
B62_txt = """A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
lines=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aas=lines[0].split()
B={}
for ln in lines[1:]:
    p=ln.split(); a=p[0]
    for b,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): B[(a,b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B.get((a,b),-4)

def nw(s1,s2,gap_open=-11,gap_ext=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),dtype=np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=gap_open+(i-1)*gap_ext
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=gap_open+(j-1)*gap_ext
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            prev=[M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]]
            k=int(np.argmax(prev)); M[i,j]=prev[k]+s; P[i,j,0]=k
            prev=[M[i-1,j]+gap_open,Ix[i-1,j]+gap_ext,Iy[i-1,j]+gap_open]
            k=int(np.argmax(prev)); Ix[i,j]=prev[k]; P[i,j,1]=k
            prev=[M[i,j-1]+gap_open,Ix[i,j-1]+gap_open,Iy[i,j-1]+gap_ext]
            k=int(np.argmax(prev)); Iy[i,j]=prev[k]; P[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]); j-=1; continue
        if j==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-'); i-=1; continue
        nxt=P[i,j,state]
        if state==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]); i-=1;j-=1
        elif state==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-'); i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]); j-=1
        state=int(nxt)
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))

def useq(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]

k9 = useq("P35527")
regions = {"head":(1,152),"coil 1A":(153,188),"L1":(189,207),"coil 1B":(208,299),
           "L12":(300,322),"coil 2":(323,461),"tail":(462,623)}

targets = {"mouse Krt9":"Q6IFX2", "human KRT10":"P13645", "human KRT14":"P02533", "human KRT16":"P08779"}
results={}
for name,acc in targets.items():
    try: s2=useq(acc)
    except Exception as e: print("fail",name,e); continue
    a1,a2 = nw(k9,s2)
    # map alignment cols -> k9 positions
    pos=0; per={r:[0,0] for r in regions}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-':
            pos+=1
            for r,(st,en) in regions.items():
                if st<=pos<=en:
                    per[r][1]+=1
                    if c1==c2: per[r][0]+=1
    results[name]={r:100*per[r][0]/per[r][1] for r in regions}
    print(f"{name}: overall id = {100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-')/len(k9):.1f}%")

import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(results).T[list(regions)]
print("\nPercent identity to human KRT9, by region:")
print(df.round(1).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(regions)); w=0.2
cols=["#2f6f4e","#3b6ea5","#c0763a","#8a4f7d"]
for i,(name,row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):
    ax.bar(x+(i-1.5)*w, row.values, w, label=name, color=cols[i%4])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(list(regions), rotation=20)
ax.set_ylabel("percent identity to human KRT9")
ax.set_title("The KRT9 rod is conserved; the glycine-rich head and tail are species and paralogue specific")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
